subject: The 3AM gift I never planned to share
preview_text: I built this in a sleepless night — just for you. No one else has seen it yet.
body_paragraphs: Last Tuesday at 3AM, I sat in the dark with my phone, exhausted from another round of edits. The app was already live, but something felt missing. So I coded this — a tiny, raw feature I wasn't going to release. I almost deleted it twice.

But then I thought about you. About those moments when the silence screams louder than any breakup ever did. When the obsessive thoughts circle like vultures. I couldn't keep it hidden. This is the thing I wish I had during my own 3AM spiral.

Open Fresh Start: Breakup Therapy and look for the hidden 'Emergency Mode' button on your home screen. It's not in the menu — it only appears when you tap the word 'Start' three times. Inside, you'll find a 60-second audio that talks you down, plus a note I wrote just for this moment.
Tap the button below to open the app and find it. I'm trusting you with this. P.S. — This disappears in 48 hours. I'm serious. Don't tell anyone I sent this.
